description.en: Loads a motion/animation file for a character handle, optionally into a specific animation pool slot and memory device.
Character handle to load the motion onto.
Path to the motion file (or a "pack|file" pair).
Optional animation pool slot to load into.
Optional named memory device to load the motion into, e.g. DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT.

example.code:
// Load an attacker's technique motion into pool 2, using the event memory device
CMND_LOAD_MOTION(ahAtk[i], path, 2, DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT);
